*   **Square A:** The shaded black area is one complete quadrant of the main square. This represents **1/4** (or 2/8) of the total area.

By geometric properties, the area of this inscribed square is exactly half the area of the containing square. This represents **1/2** (or 4/8) of the total area.
*   **Square C:** The black shape is formed by the intersection of two similar rotated squares (one horizontal, one vertical). The overlapping region forms a smaller square in the center, which has an area of **1/4** (or 2/8) of the total area.

Comparing the areas: 1/2 is greater than 1/4. Square B contains the largest black area.
